rust_summary: a creative slot set with the whole stack (`native_creative_slot_v2`), leaving `native_creative_slot` as it was.
doc_summary: `native_creative_slot_v2(player, name, slot, stack, cancel)`: an additive version of `native_creative_slot` with the whole stack put in the slot (none for an emptied one), its components included (enchantments, unbreakable, attribute modifiers, contents). Heard just before v1, which hears nothing of a packet canceled here; v1 keeps its signature and firing point. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:creative_slot_v2@`.
